explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/639: Keevash–Sudakov determined the threshold exactly, namely C(n,2) for n ≤ 5, 10 for n = 6, and ⌊n²/4⌋ for n ≥ 7. An edge {x,y} of K_n counts as uncovered if no third vertex z gives a monochromatic triangle with it. Colourings are maps Sym2 (Fin n) → Fin 2, and the diagonal values are irrelevant. The statement asserts that this value is the greatest number of uncovered edges over all colourings, for every n. Faithful.
